hero.title: Food, fun *and friends*
hero.lede: Walls of TVs for every game, a full bar that stays open late, happy hour on weekdays, and a kitchen turning out wings, burgers, sandwiches and Southern comfort-food dinners. Call in your order for pickup.

columns.title: All the time
items: CSRA food and beverage industry workers get happy hour prices
Active military, veterans and first responders get 10% off food (dine-in, with proof of service)

items.text: Tailgate Tavern offers delicious food, excellent service, plenty of seating, and walls of TVs. It makes for a great spot to watch any sporting event. I highly recommend the smoked Gouda mac and cheese bites!
The french dip was fantastic. The sandwich was so big I could only eat half. The onions were perfectly caramelized.
Excellent food and drinks as well as prompt and friendly service. I LOVE this place!!

items.a: Yes. Call (803) 226-0909 to save money and pick it up, or order through DoorDash.
The kitchen closes at 9 pm Sunday to Wednesday and 9:30 pm Thursday to Saturday. The bar stays open until 12:30 am and 1:30 am.
Yes: there are walls of TVs, so you can catch any sporting event.
Active military, veterans and first responders get 10% off food when dining in, and local food and beverage workers get happy hour prices all the time. Bring proof of service or employment.
